description: This file defines a class `SchedulersViewEdit` for handling the display and editing of scheduler jobs within the SuiteCRM module. It manages the rendering of scheduling options, including recurrence patterns, time intervals, and day selections, and extends the `ViewEdit` class to customize the user interface for scheduler editing.
